Why SEL, Why Now

NEP 2020 asks schools to educate the whole child. Insight makes it measurable.

India's National Education Policy 2020 places social, emotional, and ethical development at the heart of schooling — from holistic progress cards to life-skills education. Most schools believe in this vision; few have the tools to act on it systematically.

From intuition to data

Teachers sense when a student is struggling with confidence, belonging, or motivation. Insight turns that intuition into reliable, research-backed measurement — so support starts early, not after a crisis.

Prevent, don't just resolve

Conflict, disengagement, and exam stress are easier to prevent than to fix. Insight identifies risks at the student, classroom, and school level before they become problems.

Holistic progress, documented

Auto-generated reports give principals and counsellors clear evidence of social-emotional growth — the kind of documentation NEP 2020's holistic report cards call for.

The Insight Diagnostic

One diagnostic. 21 dimensions of every student's world.

Insight listens to how students perceive themselves, their school, and their wellbeing — with built-in checks for attention and response accuracy, so the data your school acts on is data you can trust. Explore everything it measures:

How students experience it: a friendly, age-appropriate questionnaire — not an exam. Results flow instantly into the school dashboard, and no student data is ever shared outside your school.
